$schema: Docwriter orchestrator-family task graph — full from-scratch Ralph orchestrator profile with all 29 agents + infrastructure
description: Builds the entire docwriter agent family from scratch as a Ralph orchestrator-managed profile. Includes profile infrastructure (Dockerfile, compose, setup.sh), Liquid agent templates with JIRA task context + trigger params, MCP server declarations, skill mounting, dual-write meta-knowledge persistence (Tier 1: local files + Tier 2: Ralphchives graph-RAG), Squid allowlist for research-scout, and the full 29-agent pipeline with 3 extensions.

phaseNames: Phase C: Orchestrator Wiring (profile.json, MCP, skills)

assumptions: Ralph orchestrator codebase is operational (src/ compiles, Docker works)
Target repo has NO docwriter files — everything is bootstrapped from orchestrator
Existing orchestrator profile (ralph-docs) serves as the infrastructure pattern
Agents are Liquid templates in profiles/<id>/agents/ rendered JIT to .build/
MCP sidecar provides fetch tool for research-scout (proxied through squid)
Meta-knowledge persists via host-mounted volume across container runs
JIRA is the data source — trigger comment @Docwriter on issues
Agent templates use TemplateContext variables (taskId, taskTitle, taskProject, triggerParams, isRevision, etc.)

conventions.templateContext: All TemplateContext fields from agent-includes.ts are available as Liquid variables in agent templates

tasks.title: Configure dual-write meta-knowledge persistence (Tier 1 + Tier 2)
tasks.description: Two-tier persistence strategy. Tier 1 (working memory): host-mounted volume for .docwriter/meta/ — fast local files used within sessions. Tier 2 (graph memory): knowledge-integrator also writes entries to Ralphchives via post_observation/post_task_report MCP tools → NodeBB → sync daemon → Neo4j with embeddings + entity extraction. Degraded mode: if ralphchives.enabled === false, Tier 2 is skipped — knowledge-curator/integrator templates use {% if mcpServers contains 'ralphchives-*' %} guards. Volume mount still required for Tier 1.

tier2.name: Graph memory (Ralphchives)
tier2.mechanism: MCP tools → NodeBB → sync daemon → Neo4j (embeddings + entities)

tier3.name: Community intelligence (deferred)
tier3.mechanism: Leiden clustering → community summaries → deep GraphRAG query

acceptanceCriteria: .docwriter/meta/ persists between container runs via host-mounted volume (Tier 1)
